name: design-agent-wiki-monorepo
description: Machine-First Design Agent Wiki: Curating high-performance UI registries and preventing AI slop.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @design-wiki/registry build && pnpm --filter @design-wiki/audit-linter build && pnpm --filter @design-wiki/harvester build && pnpm --filter @design-wiki/mcp build && pnpm --filter design-wiki build && pnpm --filter @design-wiki/docs build
scripts.test: pnpm test:sandbox && pnpm test:a11y && pnpm test:axe && pnpm test:agents && pnpm review:taste
